item.title: Lindsey Vonn’s Workout Video Sets Internet on Fire
item.description: Less than a week ago, Lindsey Vonn suffered an ACL rupture in an accident during a race. People were concerned that her Olympic return was over as she was evacuated to a Swiss hospital, but she reassured them on Tuesday that she still planned to compete at the Milan Cortina Games. The day before the opening ceremony, on Thursday morning, Vonn shared a video of herself exercising while squatting with several plates, set to Andy Grammer’s “Don’t Give Up On Me.” She is rapidly bouncing up and down.
